text.p: Petroleum Development Corp said it has closed its third drilling partnership in 1996, and expects to drill most, if not all of the wells for the partnership during the fourth quarter.
The partnership, designated PDC 1996-C, was closed with investor contributions of nearly $4 million, an 87 percent increase from a partnership closed in November a year ago.
Total investor contributions for three partnerships closed in 1996 were $9.2 million, compared to $5.4 million for similar partnerships in 1995.

The company said it has begun drilling the wells, and expects to drill 20 wells for the partnership during 1996. The company will retain a 20 percent working interest in each of the partnership's wells, to be located in Pennsylvania and West Virginia.
The wells will target shallow natural gas producing horizons ranging in depth from 2,000 to 5,000 feet.
Most successful partnership wells are expected to begin production during the first quarter of 1997, Petroleum Development said.
